adoption: Explanatory modules require explicit recomputation before adopting this predictor.

protocol.linear_encoding: Train-fitted one-hot (drop first), median imputation and sparse-compatible scaling; deterministic week sine/cosine inside pipeline.
protocol.lpm_probability_rule: Clip raw linear predictions to [1e-6, 1-1e-6] only when scoring probabilities.
protocol.preprocessing: All learned preprocessing is fitted only on each candidate's training data; all pipelines receive the same forty raw inputs.
protocol.probability_calibration: No post-fit recalibration; reliability bins and calibration diagnostics never modify predictions.
protocol.search_scope: Historical finite configuration lists reused; no claim of exhaustive family optimality. No early stopping.
protocol.selection: Minimum unrounded 2023 validation log loss across every registered candidate; exact ties by candidate_id.
protocol.test_status: 2024 was previously inspected; no test predictions in search, selection or calibration. Later test evaluation is exploratory.
protocol.threshold_metrics: Threshold 0.5 is descriptive only and never used for candidate selection.
protocol.training: All eligible train records; only registered balancing strategies resample training.
protocol.tree_encoding: Train-fitted full one-hot and median imputation; ordinal week.
protocol.xgb_encoding: Train-fitted ordinal codes declared categorical to XGBoost; unknown evaluation categories become missing. Numeric missing values remain native.
